local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local _ABD_DUMMY_VAR_1 = _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR
local _ABD_DUMMY_VAR_2 = { _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1, _ABD_DUMMY_VAR_1 }

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end

    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end

    end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end

    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end

    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end

    end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end

    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end

    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end

local function _ABD_SECURE_HASH_GENERATOR(_v1, _v2, _v3)
    local _h = 0x5F3759DF
    local _m = 0x5A827999
    local _k = { 0x6ED9EBA1, 0x8F1BBCDC, 0xCA62C1D6, 0x00000000, 0x1337BEEF, 0xDEADCODE }
    
    for i = 1, #_ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1 do
        local _val = _ABD_OBF_SECURE_PAD_1[i]
        _h = bit32 and bit32.bxor(_h, _val) or (_h + _val)
        _m = bit32 and bit32.band(_m, _k[math.random(1, 6)]) or (_m * 2)
    end
    
    local _obf_str_1 = "QUJELUhVQi1TRUNVUkUtT0JGVVNDQVRJT04tUEFERElORy1TVEFSVC0wMTkxMDI="
    local _obf_str_2 = "RE9OVC1UUlktVE8tREVDT01QSUxFLVRISVMtSVRTLUpVU1QtR0FSQkFHRS1EQVRB"
    local _obf_str_3 = "MTIzNDU2Nzg5MEFCQ0RFRkdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6IUAjJCVeJiooKQ=="
    
    local function _dummy_calc(_a, _b)
        if _a == _b then return bit32 and bit32.lshift(_a, 2) or (_a * 4) end
        return bit32 and bit32.rshift(_b, 1) or (_b / 2)
    end
    
    local _result_cache = {}
    for j = 1, 500 do
        table.insert(_result_cache, _dummy_calc(j, _h))
    end
    
    return _result_cache
end
